findings.title: Registered metric-alert handler is now abstract and cannot be instantiated
findings.body: MetricAlertDetectorHandler now inherits StatefulDetectorHandler but implements none of its abstract methods: counter_names, get_dedupe_value, get_group_key_values, and build_occurrence_and_event_data. Accessing detector.detector_handler for a detector with type 'metric_alert_fire' therefore raises TypeError when Detector.detector_handler attempts to instantiate it, instead of returning the previously working no-op handler. This also aborts process_detectors for the packet. Implement the required methods or retain a concrete no-op handler until metric-alert evaluation is implemented.

findings.title: Expected occurrence uses a different group key from the evaluated occurrence
findings.body: TestEvaluateGroupKeyValue.test_dedupe builds its expected occurrence using group key 'val1', but calls evaluate_group_key_value with 'group_key'. The new occurrence-building hook uses the evaluated key to build the fingerprint, so the actual occurrence has fingerprint ['<detector id>:group_key'] while the expected occurrence has ['<detector id>:val1']. The equality assertion fails even when the implementation is correct. Build the expected occurrence with 'group_key' as well.
